# Reviewkit

> Reviewkit is a WordPress plugin that displays Trustpilot reviews on any WordPress site. Paste your Trustpilot business link and click Sync Reviews — no API keys, no code, no page slowdowns. The free plugin syncs and shows reviews with grid, list and carousel layouts plus seven trust badges; Reviewkit Pro adds a no-code Widgets Builder, saved reusable widgets, review filtering, pagination and full carousel control. Rated 5/5 on WordPress.org with 1,000+ active sites. Reviewkit is independent and not affiliated with or endorsed by Trustpilot.

Reviewkit is developed by GutenSuite. Official site: https://reviewkit.gutensuite.net

## How It Works

1. Paste your Trustpilot business profile link into Reviewkit.
2. Click Sync Reviews — reviews are stored on your own site (no external calls at page load).
3. Choose a layout: grid, list or carousel, or build your own with the Pro Widgets Builder.
4. Copy the shortcode into any page, post or product page.

## Key Facts

- Product: Reviewkit — Trustpilot reviews plugin for WordPress.
- Setup requires only a Trustpilot business profile link; no API key and no developer needed.
- Reviews are stored on your site and widget styles load only on pages that display a widget, so performance is unaffected.
- Reviews refresh automatically every day (wp-cron) with an on-demand Sync Reviews button.
- Free plugin: sync and display reviews, 7 trust badges, grid/list/carousel layouts, star sorting and filtering.
- Pro plans: Pro Starter $9.99/year (1 site), Pro Growth $39.99/year (unlimited sites), Pro Agency $79.99 lifetime (unlimited sites, multisite).
- When a Pro license ends, reviews keep displaying with the free plugin; Pro features and updates pause until renewal.
- Rating: 5/5 on WordPress.org, 1,000+ active sites.
- Support: reviewkit@gutensuite.net
